reciprocal_pair.parity_intertwiner: Z=diag(1,-1) maps the odd source amplitude line to the even endpoint line
reciprocal_pair.kinematic_scope: these laws preserve the separate endpoint and history norms but do not establish the mixed full-port feedback relation

feedback_implication.assumption: the source-generated doubled Xi port pair lies in a unitary/maximal-isotropic feedback graph U, so ||Y_dbl||=||I_dbl||

converse_on_Xi_states.statement: if Re(z)=0, the Green identity gives equal input/output Gram values on each source-generated Xi vector; on any family where the full two-height cross-Gram identities also hold, the generator rule extends to an isometry and then to a unitary after defect complements
converse_on_Xi_states.qualification: diagonal norm equality alone is insufficient for a family; polarized pairwise equality is required

logical_boundary.equivalence: Xi feedback admission plus tail noncollapse implies critical-line confinement; proving admission for every nontrivial Xi state therefore contains the RH-bearing theorem rather than a merely formal coherence check
not_enough: endpoint equality at a Xi zero
logical_boundary.forbidden_shortcut: assemble block-diagonal Z and -R and call it feedback without checking endpoint-history mixed Gram entries

best_next_reduction: Compute the mixed feedback defect kernel E(w,z)=<Y_w^dbl,Y_z^dbl>-<I_w^dbl,I_z^dbl> after imposing the exact Xi reciprocal determinant relation. By Green polarization it must reduce to (z+conj(w)) times the doubled tail Gram. Any claimed categorical cancellation must explicitly annihilate this kernel; on the diagonal that claim is already confinement.
conclusion: The Pauli and Hadamard coherencers solve the kinematic parity problem, but full Xi-state feedback admission is exactly the positivity/confinement gate. It cannot be discharged as formal C4 coherence without circularly assuming the vanishing of the Green defect.
